mapper.select: SELECT OA.ID, OA.S_ID, OA.LOCATION_ID , TO_CHAR(OA.CLOSING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CLOSING_DATE , TO_CHAR(OA.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(OA.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_DATE , TO_CHAR(OA.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATE_DATE , OA.VIEW_COUNT , SI.NAME AS NAME , SI.TEL AS TEL , SI.EMAIL AS EMAIL , (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM POSTING_OFFER PO WHERE OA.ID = PO.OPEN_APPLICATION_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OFFERD FROM OPEN_APPLICATION OA, SEEKER S, SEEKER_INFO SI WHERE OA.S_ID = S.ID AND SI.S_ID = S.ID

SELECT ID, S_ID, LOCATION_ID , TO_CHAR(CLOSING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CLOSING_DATE , TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_DATE , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATE_DATE , VIEW_COUNT FROM OPEN_APPLICATION WHERE S_ID = #{s_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPEN_APPLICATION(ID, S_ID, LOCATION_ID, CLOSING_DATE, START_DATE, END_DATE) VALUES (SEQ_OPEN_APPLICATION.NEXTVAL, #{s_id}, #{location_id}, TO_DATE(#{closing_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , TO_DATE(#{start_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{end_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'))
